notes: Complete principal Palazzo Chigi exterior: all connected mapped ranges around the actual open court; pale five-row Piazza Colonna facade with original alternating pediments,rusticated corner bands,closed arched main entrance and balcony; terracotta hips/chimneys; tall western rooftop loggia,lower western court return and smaller eastern rooftop block. Montecitorio,the column/Piazza Colonna,independent neighboring blocks and interiors remain outside scope. No copied heraldry,sculpture,inscriptions or artworks. Three ordinary front,court and oblique aerial photographs were inspected. Night tricolor lighting was used only to identify the footprint,not as a material palette. Hidden rear/window inventories,arcade backing walls,roof transitions,original simplified ornament and historic grades remain medium-fi approximations. Native field slopes across the block; numeric LOD errors and physical-device timings remain unmeasured.
